findings.evidence: Lines 65–74 mention only `Subcomodule`, `toSubmodule`, and `IsCompl`; `Comodule` and `Coalgebra` themselves are defined over `[CommSemiring R]` in `TauCeti/Algebra/Coalgebra/Comodule/Basic.lean:49` and Mathlib `RingTheory/Coalgebra/Basic.lean:79`.
findings.fix: Define this predicate and its characterization under `[CommSemiring k]`; retain `[Field k]` only for `Coalgebra.IsLinearlyReductive` and the projection theorem where vector-space complements are required.
findings.issue: `Comodule.IsCompletelyReducible` and `isCompletelyReducible_def` carry an unused `[Field k]` assumption, preventing the natural semiring-level notion of a completely reducible comodule.

summary: The intrinsic complete-reducibility predicate is unnecessarily restricted to fields even though its definition uses only the general comodule and submodule APIs.
